product_constraint: 1.5x-3x real API committed Decode, exact state/logits/output, d2/d3 with joint Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total.

downward_budget.scope: Opportunity budget, not predicted savings or instruction-stall diagnosis.

mechanism: Specialize the only admitted K5120/K6144 shapes and express all five/six K1024 stages statically. Retained native prefetch, original four FMA chains and reductions remain; stage offsets and final no-prefetch tail become compile-time facts.
distinction: Rejected v51 had explicit unroll-1 and returned current/next operand records, which folded intended overlap. This has no register-feed structure and preserves retained v52 native hints. No unroll-factor or register scan.
equivalence_ledger: For thread t, stage j consumes original base=t*4+j*1024 in increasing j order.
Each original a[m][r][c] receives the same five/six fmaf operations and initial positive zero.
Original codebook, scaled BF16 publication, four-chain merge and complete warp/block trees unchanged.
Native prefetch only when another admitted stage exists; original authoritative demand loads unchanged.
Shape admission restricts FP8 to K5120/6144; no other callers gain a changed fallback.
No new allocation, state, NVFP4, Attention or Prefill change; code-size/instruction-cache and scheduling costs must be charged to real API.
gates: both builds and all-nine actual native fixed-stage kernels without spill; backward stage loop must be absent
36 complete FP8 projection/guard cases and full P65 state/cache/transactions
immediate d2 API vs v52; >3% slowdown stops, useful unlocks d3, otherwise remove
expiry: Useful dependency only until next complete verifier API return or archival; no unroll-factor/register scan or production switch.
